profile_reconciliation.rank_8_treatment: EXCLUDED, and priced exactly as the base invoice prices it. research/coded-reverse-controller/verify.py defines two profiles: P_OLD = {1:2237, 2:388, 3:494, 4:147, 5:36, 8:8} for the joint-helper-lattice word, and P_NEW = {1:2201, 2:412, 3:510, 4:127, 5:40} for PR4929. invoice(p, pat, thick, prof) prices exactly the dict it is given -- it has no built-in rank-8 rule. The eight rank-8 events are the owned C0 centre calls, which the PR4929 center-free construction removes; the p19 chain emits no CENTRE gate at all, so P_NEW is the applicable profile and rank 8 is absent by construction, not by omission. The frozen comparison word retains its centre calls, which is why its declared profile still shows 8:8.
